svg.title: dev-loop-ultralight — the minimal loop
svg.desc: Flowchart of dev-loop-ultralight: the six-point eligibility gate that is the loop's entire safety mechanism; a single handoff for implement-and-test; one reviewer sweeping all nine review concerns in one pass; triage; the mandatory, one-way escalation exits to dev-loop-lite and the full dev-loop; a single fix round with no second round and no verification phase; and the walkthrough and PR that close it out.
